cases.title: Shared project report endpoint
cases.prompt: The route authenticates the requester. Identify the access-control risk and cite the line that returns data.

reference.rationale: Any authenticated user can request another tenant's report: the return is not gated by report ownership or tenant membership.

cases.title: Retrying a payment request
cases.prompt: The charge request can time out after the provider accepts it. Identify the failure mode and cite the retry line.

reference.rationale: A blind retry without a stable idempotency key or reconciliation may charge the same order twice.

cases.title: Render a user label
cases.prompt: Assume standard React text rendering and no other code. Decide whether this snippet alone shows an HTML injection vulnerability.

reference.rationale: React renders the interpolated value as text by default; this snippet alone does not use an HTML injection API.
